name: SM_Snow_House_Lower_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: ground storey of the snow-country house, 10 x 10 m and 3 m high: dark timber frame, grey plaster panels, bands of leaded windows, two doorways with stone steps
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A box of plaster with the frame laid on it: timbers are bevelled blocks without joints or pegs, windows are opaque dark leaded panels, doorways are dark recesses (the snow_house_door asset goes in front). It has no top: it is meant to carry the timbered storey. One 4096 px bake covers the whole building, about 100 px/m: it holds at the gameplay camera and is soft at 1 m (a tiling masonry material with trim would be the engine-side answer). Walls are flat slabs with the coursing in the textures; the inside is a dark core, not a room. One convex hull is exported.
stacking: SM_Snow_House_Timber_PR sits on top at z = 3.0 m; SM_Snow_House_Roof_PR at z = 5.8 m; all three share the same centre
